expression.null_semantics: NullIntolerant: null in => null out. Exception: out can be NULL for non-null input in float->timestamp (NaN/Inf), timestamp->int/short/byte on Spark 4.0 (nullifyOverflows), try_cast overflow, date->numeric. Cast.forceNullable(from,to) decides output nullability; fused output nullability must equal GpuCast.nullable.
expression.non_ansi_behavior: Integral narrowing wraps (modular). float/double->integral: truncate, saturate, NaN->0 (byte/short go through int then wrap on CPU). int/long->float/double RN. double->float RN, overflow Inf. timestamp->long floor seconds; ->double micros/1e6. long->timestamp saturating multiply. float/double->timestamp NaN/Inf=>NULL. bool<->numeric 0/1. float->bool x!=0.
expression.ansi_behavior: Throws ArithmeticException (CAST_OVERFLOW) for out-of-range narrowing, float->integral NaN/Inf/out of range, timestamp->narrow-int overflow; try_cast returns NULL instead. GpuCast.hasSideEffects returns true for these (GpuCast.scala:1666-1695) => must not be fused / not reordered in v1.
rapids_notes: GpuCast.doCast is a single big match (GpuCast.scala:295); the default branch is cudf castTo(static_cast) (:641).

Special code: (Float,Long)|(Double,Int|Long) NaN->0 first (:544); timestamps via floorDiv (:324-376); long->timestamp saturating (:1611); bool/int->timestamp via TIMESTAMP_SECONDS (:524-533); date->numeric -> all NULL (:314).

Config gates: spark.rapids.sql.castFloatToIntegralTypes.enabled (default true, :114), castFloatToDecimal, castDecimalToFloat, castFloatToString, castStringToFloat, castStringToTimestamp (not relevant to numeric matrix).
Spark-version shims: CastTimeToIntShim.ifNullifyOverflows false on spark330-35x, true from 4.0/db143 (timestamp->int/short/byte).
Fusion reference semantics = unfused GPU; CPU-vs-GPU diffs (e.g. float->byte/short) must be recorded in KNOWN-DIFFS and the fused kernel should match the GPU path (or fall back).
Cast chain nuance: casts within the same region are independent device functions; for exactness never merge (float)(int)x style chains algebraically.
expression.whitelist_reason: Deterministic rowwise, fixed width. v1: integral widen/narrow (wrap), int/long->float/double, float->double, double->float, any numeric->bool, bool->numeric, float/double->int/long, timestamp->long/double, small-int->timestamp, long->timestamp (non-ANSI), timestamp<->date in UTC only. v2: float/double->byte/short, timestamp->int/short/byte (version dependent), timestamp->float, non-UTC tz. NO: ANSI/try_cast with throwing, float/double->timestamp, date->numeric, string, decimal (precision/scale + 128-bit + overflow-to-null logic, castFloat/DecimalToX config differences).
